answer: The whisper schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the marble checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 43 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. Anyone wanting 69 effective identities must lock that capital for 43 epochs and keep it locked through every sable audit. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
